title: Humanitarians in Libya
author: Julie Wark
content:
What can ten humanitarian activists tell us about today’s (and yesterday’s)
geopolitics? In politics, and especially genocidal politics, the micro can say
much more about the macro than the macro about the micro. Reduced to macro
arguments among pundits and politicians about whether the enormity of genocide
